How it works

Working Principle of Form Fill Seal Packing Machine

Roll Film Feeding

Laminated packaging film roll is mounted onto machine unwinding system

Pouch Forming Process

Film passes through forming collar or forming section to create pouch shape

➜ Machine continuously forms pouches from roll-fed laminate film automatically.

Product Filling Operation

Machine fills: ✔ Powders ✔ Granules ✔ Pan masala ✔ Tobacco ✔ Spices ✔ Snacks ✔ Liquids (optional systems) accurately into formed pouches.

Sealing & Cutting Process

Heat sealing jaws seal pouch securely: Center seal Side seal Three-side seal Four-side seal Pouches are cut automatically into individual packets.

Coding & Printing Integration

Optional systems include: Batch coding Date printing QR code printing Barcode printing

Finished Pouch Discharge

Packed pouches discharged automatically for: Collection Cartoning Secondary packaging Dispatch operations
